Name: Crops Watered Indicator
Author: snowe2010
Description:
Provides indication of whether crops are watered or not. Uses a simple tint value over the crops to darken them.

Configuration of how dark to make the crops can be set in config.json

Valid tint values are any number between 0 and 1. Default is 0.35


[url=https://github.com/snowe2010/starbound-mods]Source code here[/url]

Downloads.Description:
Update for SV 1.6 and SMAPI 4.0.4

Also reverses the logic to _darken_ crops when they are watered rather than lighten them. This seems to have been everyone's preference so it's finally fixed after 6 years.

Manifest.Name: CropsWateredIndicator
Manifest.Description: Shows an indication if the crops have been watered
